summary: Keep the full link target clickable across wrapped request, agent, conversation and Markdown content in Fractal TUI

schema.detail: No client-v0 schema or generated client changes.

rules.detail: No authoring or runtime policy changes.

compatibility.detail: Visible text and card layout are unchanged. OSC 8 segments share an explicit ID and full target; terminals without OSC 8 retain ordinary text and app click-to-copy.

recovery.detail: Revert the rendering change; no stored data changes.
